summary: LTP on an equity and Quote on an index: the ltpc packet gives the LTP frame; the index packet gives OHLC from the day candle, the previous close and the change, and nothing an index does not carry.

deviations.reason: The web's Upstox LTP payload carries no timestamp; the docs' LTP frame does (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md, LTP: ltp and timestamp), and the docs rank above the adapter, so the desktop keeps it.

The desktop's index frames add price_change and price_change_percent. The web's Upstox adapter sends no change for an index. Lead ruling 2026-11-09: price_change and price_change_percent are not docs keys, so an index frame carries them only as each broker's web adapter sends them; the desktop follows the adapter (lane wire dialect, phase B).

The web's Upstox LTP payload names the previous close cp; A key the web sends from some mode up is sent in that mode and every mode above it, so a script reading it on the richer frame meets no KeyError (feed/dialect/names.rs rules, docs/port/market-data-frames.md).
